embeds.title: 🟢 INTERPOL Operation Ramz Seizes 53 Malware Phishing Servers
embeds.description:
INTERPOL's Operation Ramz resulted in the arrest of more than 200 individuals and identification of 382 additional suspects across 13 Middle East and North Africa countries. Authorities seized 53 servers used for phishing, malware, and online fraud affecting at least 3,867 confirmed victims. The operation dismantled multiple cybercrime schemes including investment scams, phishing-as-a-service platforms, and malware distribution networks across Algeria, Bahrain, Egypt, Iraq, Jordan, Lebanon, Libya, Morocco, Oman, Palestine, Qatar, Tunisia, and the UAE.
